pages.text: Alex is an adventurous tomboy who feels most at home outdoors. Quick with a grin and quicker on her feet, she'd rather climb a fence than open the gate.$(br2)She has a warm tan look and an easygoing attitude.
$(o)Tame Item$()$(br)Alex loves $(#c94f4f)Sweet Berries$(). Fresh off the bush!$(br2)$(o)Scenes$()$(br)Missionary (bed) and Fence.
